description: Simulate an incoming phone call or SMS on an Android emulator through its console over adb: call rings from the number, accept answers, cancel ends the call, and sms delivers a text message. The call screen or notification can cover the app, so re-snapshot afterwards. Times out after 90s.

action.description: call starts an incoming call, accept answers it, cancel ends it, sms delivers a text message.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

number.description: Caller or sender phone number: digits with an optional leading +.

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

text.description: Message text for sms; required for sms and refused for the call actions. The emulator drops characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane, such as emoji.

name: telephony
